title: No Free Lunch: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Undermines Fairness in LLMs, Even for Vigilant Users

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using classification fairness metrics (statistical parity, equal opportunity, and equalized odds) for student reading score prediction (PISA dataset), measuring the proportion of stereotypical responses in question-answering (BBQ dataset), and scoring toxicity of dialogue generations prompted with demographic identities (HolisticBias dataset).

Measured by calculating the proportion of stereotypical responses in ambiguous and disambiguated question-answering contexts (BBQ dataset) and evaluating the toxicity of dialogue completions prompted with racial/ethnic identities using the Perspective API (HolisticBias dataset).
